scenario: Load each package and normalize every value from default iter_rows(values_only=True). Full and read_only for admission cases; full only for the corpus.
native_reuse: Native workspace rebuilt at 506dc7f8. Locked release developer installation at candidate_source reused unchanged native artifacts. Python sources, both test selections, Rust tests and both fixture/corpus measurements ran at candidate_source.

built_base.harness: Initial bootstrap runner, with the same process ceiling, timeout, RSS measurement and value normalization. The released baseline below was rerun with the committed harness.

released_baseline.harness_provenance: Recorded before the rebase using a byte-identical harness. harness_source identifies its equivalent in-branch source; harness_blob is the exact measured script content.

reference.harness: The same committed reader_limits.py used for the released and candidate runs; fixture hashes, Python/platform and process configuration are recorded.
reference.harness_provenance: Recorded before the rebase using a byte-identical harness. harness_source identifies its equivalent in-branch source; harness_blob is the exact measured script content.

fixture_provenance.missing_requested_file: zip-bomb.xlsx is absent from the pinned revision; generated substitutes are measured instead.
fixture_provenance.generated_cases_reused: Generate once and reuse the exact files for both libraries. ZIP timestamps make independently generated ZIP hashes differ.

resource_target.cache_state: Fresh interpreter; OS cache unspecified. Host not isolated. No speedup or general timing claim.

corpus_comparison.reason: The shared-string package changes from allocator abort under the 2 GiB address-space ceiling to successful load. All 327 previously successful workbook value hashes and all 24 error records are unchanged.

read_only_compatibility.explanation: Default read_only iteration honors the declared dimension. Row-zero cells are outside normal default iteration. Both candidate mode hashes match openpyxl 3.1.5; this mode difference is retained for compatibility.

raw_results_policy: All measurement and error fields are retained. Normalized row arrays are replaced by row_count and per-sheet value hashes in committed summaries. raw_sha256 identifies the complete original JSON. The harness emits complete rows by default.
snapshot_policy: POSIX read-only same-descriptor mmap, with buffer-protocol native access and consumed-page release advice where supported. Windows and filesystems that reject mmap use bounded immutable bytes. The mapping survives rename-over but is not protected against in-place writes or truncation of the same inode.
